title: Log Entry
description: JSON Schema for platform logs. All services must emit logs conforming to this structure.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the log entry

event_type.description: Optional event type for structured logging (e.g., 'platform_token_issued', 'health_check_failed')

actor.description: URI identifying who triggered the event: {type}:{id} (e.g. 'clinician:usr_abc123', 'service:auth-worker')

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code or short explanation (e.g. 'bad_secret', 'role not in allow-list')

trace_id.description: W3C trace ID — 32-char lowercase hex. Correlates a request across services.

span_id.description: W3C span ID — 16-char lowercase hex. Identifies this unit of work within a trace.

service.description: Name of the service emitting the log (e.g. 'authentication').
